words.zh: 印象派的,给人深刻印象的
words.ex_en: His paintings had become more impressionistic as his eyesight dimmed.
words.ex_zh: 随着他的视力减弱，他的画变得越来越富有印象派风格。

words.zh: 令人难忘地,  令人印象深刻地

words.ex_en: It was the improvisation of the ebullition.
words.ex_zh: 它是激情迸发的即兴创作。 哟！

words.ex_en: The brain cells are inactive during sleep.
words.ex_zh: 在睡觉时脑细胞不活跃。

words.ex_en: Don’t suddenly take up violent exercise after years of inactivity.
words.ex_zh: 多年没锻炼不要突然进行剧烈运动。

words.ex_en: Attempting to drown herself in inanity, she marries Peter Keating, only to leave him for newspaper tycoon Gail Wynand, publisher of the Banner, where Toohey's column appears.
words.ex_zh: 为了把自己淹没在空虚之中，她先嫁给了彼特·基廷，然后仅仅是为了离开他而选择了报业大亨盖尔·威纳德。 威纳德是巴纳出版社的老板，也就是图希的专栏出现的地方。

words.ex_en: A serious fall incapacitated the 68-year-old congressman.
words.ex_zh: 一次严重跌伤使这位68岁的国会议员丧失了行动能力。

words.ex_en: And it can be frustrating to watch a beloved pet scratch incessantly—especially after you’ve tried everything to get rid of the pests.
words.ex_zh: 看着自己心爱的宠物不停地挠啊挠相当令人烦躁——尤其是在你费尽心思除去那些害虫的时候。

words.ex_en: The adorable inchworm is really the caterpillar of the geometer moth.
words.ex_zh: 可爱的尺蠖就是尺蠖毛虫。

words.ex_en: Increased motivation is more than an incidental benefit of reward schemes.
words.ex_zh: 积极性提高不仅仅是奖励计划附带的益处。

words.ex_en: Carbon monoxide is released when carbon in fuel—both plants and fossil fuels like gasoline—burns incompletely.
words.ex_zh: 当作为燃料的碳——包括植物和化石燃料比如汽油——不完全燃烧时，就会产生一氧化碳。

words.ex_en: There were several glaring inconsistencies (= very noticeable differences ) in his report.
words.ex_zh: 他的报告中有几个明显的前后矛盾之处。

words.ex_zh: “你把车卖了？”她难以置信地问道。
